key.name: streaming-mode
key.description: streaming: partial hypotheses appear in the field as you speak. batch: the transcript is injected once, when the utterance ends. auto: resolved per machine against the measured RTF tier table, which is also what decides whether in-field partials are shown at all.

key.name: language
key.summary: Language hint sent to the backend
key.description: A BCP-47-ish code (en, fr, zh) passed to the inference backend as a session hint. Empty means "let the backend decide", which is what a multilingual model does best.

key.name: activation
key.summary: How a press reaches the daemon
key.description: auto: the portal where the app is packaged (the compositor can only identify a packaged app), the control socket otherwise. portal and control force one - a wrong choice here means the hotkey does nothing, so auto is nearly always right.

key.name: hotkey
key.summary: Preferred shortcut offered to the portal
key.description: An accelerator such as '<Super>d'. It is a *preference*: under portal activation the desktop's own bind dialog owns the final choice, and empty means "offer no preference".
